sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Invoice"."CustomerId" AS e, "Customer"."Country" AS g, SUM("Invoice"."Total") AS m1 FROM "Invoice" JOIN "Customer" ON "Customer"."CustomerId" = "Invoice"."CustomerId"  GROUP BY "Invoice"."CustomerId", "Customer"."Country"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of invoice total amount per Customer within Customer.Country (additive)
share of the all total of total of invoice total amount (all level)
rank within the group by total of invoice total amount, keep the top 3
